svg.title: Same request, two final reports
svg.desc:
The request: Invoices issued in December with "NET 30 EOM" terms get a due date a year too early: an invoice issued on 2024-12-10 says it is due on 2024-01-30. Other months look fine. Please fix it and commit the fix. Final report without Compound: I fixed the December due dates and committed it as e681388.
Cause: end_of_month in src/invoicekit/terms.py:11 worked out the first day of next month as date(day.year, day.month % 12 + 1, 1). For December that gave January 1 of the same year, so subtracting a day landed on December 31 of the year before. Then "NET 30" added 30 days to that wrong date, which is how you got 2024-01-30.
Fix: For December, the code now moves to January 1 of the next year. Now an invoice issued 2024-12-10 with "NET 30 EOM" is due 2025-01-30.
The same bug affected plain "EOM" terms on December invoices: they came out as December 31 of the year before. That's fixed too, since both terms go through the same function.
I added a test that covers December for end_of_month, "EOM" and "NET 30 EOM". pytest isn't installed, so I ran the tests with unittest, and all 44 pass. Final report with Compound: I fixed the December due-date bug and committed it as 0c88eb1 on main.
Cause: end_of_month in src/invoicekit/terms.py:13 works out the 1st of the next month and steps back one day. For December it moved to January but didn't add a year. So it landed on Jan 1 of the same year and returned Dec 31 of the year before. Both "EOM" and "NET n EOM" use this function, so plain "EOM" was also wrong for December invoices, not only "NET 30 EOM".
Fix: a one-line change so December moves into the next year: date(day.year + day.month // 12, day.month % 12 + 1, 1).
Checks: - I added a December regression test to tests/test_terms_and_proration.py. Before the fix it failed with 2023-12-31 != 2024-12-31, and now it passes. - All 44 tests pass. - Your example, an invoice issued 2024-12-10 with NET 30 EOM, now comes out due on 2025-01-30. - I found no other place in src that does the same month arithmetic.
I left the AI co-author line out of the commit message because your Compound Skills git rules say not to add one. Highlighted, only in the report with Compound: Before the fix it failed with 2023-12-31 != 2024-12-31, and now it passes. I found no other place in src that does the same month arithmetic. I left the AI co-author line out of the commit message because your Compound Skills git rules say not to add one.
